log.msg: STRANGER: a stranger at 1280 would say - a page called YouTube with a video and a dense settings panel, plus a list of five other labs (Course/Yield/Split/Chat/Marks) whose names alone do not say what they do. MEANT (readme.md + page.js content()): five/six labs proving the YouTube IFrame Player API - a control panel, a course whose chapters are real pages, and three ways a polled timeline can drive UI (yield/split/chat), built on one shared cues() engine. The on-screen takeaway sentence already says this plainly ("Five labs on the IFrame Player API. Press play on any of them") so the two sentences are CLOSE, not divergent - the gap is only that a stranger cannot yet tell Course/Yield/Split/Chat/Marks apart by name alone until they click one (each child page then states its own one-line purpose immediately).

PRIMARY INTERACTION BUG (confirmed + fixed): panel/ is the youtube page's `default` column - shown on cold landing without ever being routed to. core/Page/Page.class.js render_column() only calls .render() on a default column, never .activate() (line ~307) - so panel's own activated() (which attaches the keydown listener for the whole keyboard legend: Space, arrows, J/L, M, 0-9) NEVER ran on a cold /imagine/youtube/ load. Verified with Playwright: pressing every documented key silently did nothing (0 feed entries, 0 preventDefault) on the default landing, while the SAME keys worked instantly once routed directly to /imagine/youtube/panel/. Worse: because deactivated() also never ran, pressing play then navigating to a different top-level page (e.g. /imagine/design/) left the 4x/second getCurrentTime() poll running forever - Player.live stayed at 1 instead of returning to 0, exactly the invariant readme.md's Watch-out section calls out as the one thing that must never happen.

FIX applied to public/imagine/youtube/page.js: added activated(){ this.default_column()?.activate(); } and deactivated(){ this.default_column()?.deactivate(); } on the parent youtube page, mirroring the exact workaround core/Page/overview/columns/uses/split/page.js already uses for a never-routed REGION (activated(){ this.children.forEach(page => page.activate()); }) - same problem, one level of the arrangement contract over (a never-routed COLUMN instead of a never-routed region). Verified after the fix: (1) keyboard shortcuts fire correctly on a cold /imagine/youtube/ load (pressed m, feed logged mute()); (2) Player.live drops from 1 to 0 after navigating away while playing; (3) no regression on the routed /imagine/youtube/panel/ url - single yt-stage, no double-activation, feed shows exactly one entry per keypress; (4) switching panel -> course through the router still cleans up the poll normally. Zero console errors in every run. CAVEAT: this treats the symptom at the one call site that has it (my realm's only default column) - render() and activate() are both idempotent so re-entry is a safe no-op even once panel is genuinely routed to, but the real fix belongs in render_column() itself so every default column site-wide gets it for free; written up as a proposal in doc/decisions.md since core/ is out of fence. Undo trigger: if a future core fix makes default columns activate() automatically, this becomes a harmless no-op and can be deleted.

log.msg: SECOND FIX: dead doc links, the exact wave-known pattern (Router never intercepts a link ending in an extension). readme.md and all five doc/*.md files (api, cues, decisions, marks, yield) cross-linked each other with raw `./whatever.md` / `/imagine/youtube/doc/whatever.md` paths - every one of them was a full unstyled page load onto raw markdown text (confirmed live: clicking one left the app shell entirely, landed on a bare <pre> tag). Fixed with blogx's own precedent: added public/imagine/youtube/doc/page.js (route(name) + md.file(), undeclared on purpose so it does not compete with the six labs on the index) and rewrote every .md link in readme.md and the five doc files to the matching trailing-slash in-app route (/imagine/youtube/doc/<name>/). Verified: all 5 routes render inside the app shell with correct headings; a cross-link from doc/cues/ to doc/api/ stays in-app (confirmed after scoping the locator past a duplicate/hidden anchor - cues.md links api.md twice in its own prose); zero console errors on the landing page after adding the new file. CAVEAT: doc/page.js is undeclared (no files: property, no children: entry) matching the blogx precedent exactly - if this module ever grows a Docs tab via files:, this route and that declaration would want to agree on the same five names rather than drift.

assign.outcome:
**Landed — two real bugs found and fixed, one width decision confirmed still open.** The stranger/meant sentences are close (this realm's authors already wrote honest takeaway sentences on all six pages), so the highest-value finding here was not wording — it was that the page's own promise didn't hold. `panel/` — the `default` column, so the very first thing on screen — is shown by `render_column()` (`core/Page/Page.class.js`) without ever being `activate()`-d, so its `activated()` never attached the keydown listener: every key on the on-screen keyboard legend (Space, arrows, J/L, M, 0-9) silently did nothing on a cold load, and the poll leaked forever if you played the video and left. Fixed with the same workaround `core/Page/overview/columns/uses/split/page.js` already carries for a never-routed region, verified with Playwright (keyboard mute now flips the readout and logs `mute()`; `Player.live` returns to 0 after navigating away). Second: every cross-link between `readme.md` and the five `doc/*.md` files was a raw `.md` path — the wave's known dead-doc-link pattern — fixed with blogx's own precedent (`doc/page.js` route shim, trailing-slash urls everywhere). Both fixes verified live, zero console errors. The 3440 critique row (rank 17, 62% used, 1028px dead, score 82) is unchanged and stays open on purpose: `doc/decisions.md` already has a measured, shot-backed rejection of the obvious widen-it fix (`fill` makes a 2340px video, taller than the viewport), so the critique's real alternate — a genuine fourth column — is logged as an owner decision, not built live.

![fixed control panel, keyboard-muted](/framework/ai/2026-09-04/imagine-review/shots/youtube.jpg)

**Fixed (2):** the default column's `activated()`/`deactivated()` never firing (keyboard dead + poll leak) — `page.js`; five dead `doc/*.md` cross-links across `readme.md` and all `doc/*.md` files — new `doc/page.js` route shim + rewritten links.
**Proposed (2, need core/, not applied):** a `render_column()` fix so every `default` column site-wide gets proper lifecycle for free (diff in `doc/decisions.md`); nothing else — the width alternate is logged as an in-fence owner decision, not a core proposal.
**Left open, with reason:** the 3440 dead-space alternate (a fourth column) is real design work, not a caveat-and-ship fix — recorded in `doc/decisions.md` under Open.
